description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Reward' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Reward templates — reusable bundles of currency + items + buffs that can be granted to a player. Referenced by Quest, TimedEvent, CoopEvent, Season, DailyLogin, Referral, etc. Define a reward once here, then reference it everywhere instead of inlining payouts.

ClaimLimitOverride.description: Per-tier override of limits and cooldown for a ClaimRewardDefinition. One best-matching override by MinPremiumTier is picked; null fields fall back to base values.

CooldownSeconds.description: Override for CooldownSeconds. Null does not override.

MaxClaimsPerWindow.description: Override for MaxClaimsPerWindow. Null does not override; 0 removes the limit for this tier.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier this override applies to.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Specific premium-ID. Null means any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

TotalClaimLimit.description: Override for TotalClaimLimit. Null does not override.

WindowSeconds.description: Override for WindowSeconds. Null does not override.

ClaimRewardDefinition.description: Config of a simple claim reward. Covers one-shot, repeating-with-limits, and server-triggered scenarios; all limits are optional and combinable.

Availability.description: Claim limits — unified LimitSpec: CooldownSeconds (min seconds between claims); MaxPerWindow + WindowSeconds (sliding "N per M seconds", checked against RecentClaimTimestamps, not calendar-aligned); TotalCap (all-time, 1 = one-shot). 0 on an axis = no limit. Per-tier overrides via PremiumLimitOverrides.

AvailableFromUtc.description: Reward is unavailable before this UTC moment.

AvailableUntilUtc.description: Reward is unavailable from this UTC moment onwards.

ClaimID.description: Unique identifier. Used as the key in UserRewardState.Claims. Must not contain '.' or '$'.

Mode.description: Who initiates the claim. Manual: player via client API. Auto: server-only (background job, GM grant, compensation); client calls are rejected.

PremiumLimitOverrides.description: Per-tier overrides of limits and cooldown for premium players. One best-matching override is picked (highest MinPremiumTier) — does not stack.

Presets.description: Preset wiring (the Availability block). null = presets unused.

Rewards.description: Reward to grant. Supports the full premium logic (PremiumBonuses / PremiumTiers).

x-enum-descriptions: Player initiates the claim via the client API (RewardV2.ClaimReward).
Server-only (background job, GM grant, anti-fraud compensation). Client ClaimReward is rejected.
Platform was not reported, or the reported one contradicts the request fingerprint.
Browser: web build, WebGL, or a messenger mini-app.
Android build (Google Play Billing).
iOS / iPadOS build (App Store, StoreKit).

ComebackRewardDefinition.description: Config of a single comeback reward (for return after long absence). Tier is locked at the moment of return, not at claim time.

Availability.description: Who can access the comeback — unified SegmentGate. null/empty = everyone. Lives in the Availability block so it can be shared via presets.

AvailableFromUtc.description: Comeback is unavailable before this UTC moment.

AvailableUntilUtc.description: Comeback is unavailable from this UTC moment onwards.

ClaimCooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive comeback claims of this config. 0 means no limit.

ClaimWindowSeconds.description: Seconds the pending reward stays available for claim after return. Beyond it the pending is cleared. 0 means infinite.

ComebackID.description: Unique comeback config identifier. Used as the key in UserRewardState.Comebacks. Must not contain '.' or '$'.

Presets.description: Preset wiring (the Availability block). null = presets unused.

Tiers.description: Reward tiers by absence duration. The tier with the largest matching MinAbsenceSeconds is locked when pending is fixed.

TrackPresenceOnRead.description: Whether to update LastSeenAt and fix pending in read-only methods. True tracks presence on any call; false confines updates to claim methods.

ComebackTier.description: One tier of a comeback reward.

MinAbsenceSeconds.description: Minimum absence in seconds to qualify for this tier. Compared against (now - LastSeenAt).TotalSeconds at return time.

Rewards.description: Tier reward. Supports the full premium logic (PremiumBonuses / PremiumTiers).

x-enum-descriptions: Step: hold the previous point's value until the next one. Behaviour of an unset field.
Linear between adjacent points.
Geometric between adjacent points: lo * (hi/lo)^t.

CurvePoint.description: One breakpoint of a table curve.

AtStep.description: Step (level / rank / stage) at which this point takes effect. Empty = the point is ignored.

Value.description: Value at this point. Empty = the point is ignored.

x-enum-descriptions: Value does not change with the step. Same behaviour as an unset curve.
Additive in the value's own units: base + PerStep * (step - firstStep).
Additive share of the base: base * (1 + PerStepRate * (step - firstStep)). 0.1 = +10% of base per step.
Compounding: base * (1 + GrowthRate)^(step - firstStep).
Table of multipliers over the base: base * interpolate(Points, step).
Table of absolute values: interpolate(Points, step). The base is ignored.

DailyCalendarDefinition.description: Config of one daily-reward calendar: an ordered sequence of days with per-day rewards. Miss-behavior and claim-mode are calendar-level settings.

AssetPaths.description: Arbitrary UI assets (icon, banner, background, etc.). Designer-defined keys. Does not affect server logic.

Availability.description: Who can access the calendar — unified SegmentGate. null/empty = everyone. Lives in the Availability block so it can be shared via presets.

AvailableFromUtc.description: Calendar is unavailable before this UTC moment. Null means no lower bound.

AvailableUntilUtc.description: Calendar is unavailable from this UTC moment onwards. Null means no upper bound.

CalendarID.description: Unique calendar identifier. Used as the key in UserRewardState.DailyCalendars. Must not contain '.' or '$'.

ClaimCooldownSeconds.description: Used only with ClaimMode = SlidingWindow: minimum seconds between consecutive claims.

ClaimMode.description: Mode that determines when a new claim becomes available.

Days.description: Per-day reward config sorted by DayNumber. Day numbers must be unique starting from 1.

DisplayName.description: Display name of the calendar for UI.

IsLooping.description: After the last day: true loops back to day 1 (infinite calendar); false stops giving rewards.

MissBehavior.description: Action to take on a missed-window progress (see MissThresholdMultiplier).

MissThresholdMultiplier.description: Allowed-miss multiplier. Default 2.0 means more than 2 claim units missed in a row triggers MissBehavior.

Presets.description: Preset wiring (the Availability block). null = presets unused.

ResetByDays.description: Used only with MissBehavior = ResetBy: number of days to roll CollectedDays back on miss. Lower bound is 0.

x-enum-descriptions: New claim available on a new UTC date (LastClaimAt.Date < today). Simple and predictable; ignores player timezone.
New claim available ClaimCooldownSeconds after the previous one. Timezone-friendly but the claim slot drifts over time.
Miss has no effect; next day = CollectedDays + 1. Soft calendar.
On miss, resets CollectedDays to 0. Streak calendar.
On miss, rolls CollectedDays back by ResetByDays. Partial penalty.

DailyRewardDay.description: Config of one day in a daily-rewards calendar.

AssetPaths.description: Optional per-day assets (day icon, chest artwork). Designer-defined keys.

DayNumber.description: Explicit day number (starting from 1). Unique within the calendar; next expected day = CollectedDays + 1.

IsMilestone.description: UI flag for a milestone day (e.g. day 7/14/30). Does not affect server logic; only a hint for the client.

Rewards.description: Rewards for this day. Supports the full platform premium logic via PremiumBonuses / PremiumTiers.

EventTokenAddress.description: Universal event-token address. Uniquely identifies the system and event the tokens belong to.

EntityID.description: Event identifier within the system. In TITLE CONFIG (rewards written by a designer or an AI agent) scheduled systems use the SHORT form — the cycle number is unknowable at config time: "{TimedEventID}" / "{LeaderboardID}" = whichever instance is active at grant time, or "{ID}:{ChainedEventID}" = that chain phase in the current cycle. The engine (EventTokenAddressResolver in ResourceService) expands it before granting; a grant with no active instance is dropped. At RUNTIME the bucket address is always the full form "{EntityID}:{InstanceKey}": TimedEvent Scheduled → "{TimedEventID}:s{yyyyMMddHHmm}"; TimedEvent Chain → "{chainID}:{cycleIndex}:{chainedEventID}"; Leaderboard → "{leaderboardID}:{instanceKey}"; CoopEvent → CoopChainID; Season → SeasonChainID.

EventTokenOperation.description: Information about granted event tokens. Returned in Board_Roll, QuestComplete and other responses. All multipliers (Roll/Premium/BonusWindow/ProgressiveTier/SeasonBuffs) are applied via ModifierService before ResourceService; this carries the final amount. Use ModifierApplyResult alongside ResourceOperation if UI needs multiplier breakdown.

Address.description: Event token address — where to grant or consume.

Amount.description: Token amount — how many to grant or consume.

Source.description: Operation source (sourceKey used for analytics and limits).

ExperimentVariantCondition.description: Experiment-variant membership condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. The gate passes if the player is assigned to one of Variants of experiment ExperimentID (empty list = just enrolled). A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: make two configs (offer A, offer B), each gated to its variant.

ExperimentID.description: Experiment ID whose assignment is checked.

Variants.description: Allowed variants (any-of). Empty = being assigned to any variant is enough (enrolled). A player with no assignment for this experiment does NOT pass.

IdleAccrualDefinition.description: Config of one idle-income accrual. Income accrues at IdleRateConfig while offline; claim computes accrued seconds (capped), applies the rate, and scales Rewards.

AccrualID.description: Unique accrual identifier. Used as the key in UserRewardState.IdleAccruals. Must not contain '.' or '$'.

AvailableFromUtc.description: Accrual is unavailable before this UTC moment. Null means no lower bound. Also used as accrual-start with AccruedFromConfigStart.

AvailableUntilUtc.description: Accrual is unavailable from this UTC moment onwards. Null means no upper bound.

FirstClaimMode.description: Behavior on the player's first access to this accrual (when LastCollectAt = MinValue).

MaxAccumulationSeconds.description: Max accumulation time in seconds. Time beyond this is forfeited. 0 means no cap (risky for long-term economy).

MinClaimSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two claims of the same accrual. Anti-spam. 0 means no limit.

Rate.description: Rate composition. Final rate per second = (base + Power and BoardRank coefficients + equipment IdleRateBonus sum) × best premium multiplier.

Requirements.description: Activation requirements. All must be satisfied at claim time, otherwise the claim is denied. Denial does not move LastCollectAt.

Rewards.description: Base reward set. Standard amounts are multiplied by (accruedSeconds × finalRatePerSecond) at claim time. PremiumBonuses/PremiumTiers pass through to ResourceService.

IdleAccrualRequirements.description: Accrual activation conditions. Each field is optional; all set conditions must hold simultaneously (AND).

Availability.description: Premium/audience gate — unified SegmentGate. null/empty = not checked. (Gameplay requirements MinCharacterLevel/RequiredEquippedItemIDs stay separate.) Lives in the Availability block so it can be shared via presets.

MinCharacterLevel.description: Minimum level of RequirementsCharacterID. 0 means the condition is not checked.

RequiredEquippedItemIDs.description: ItemIDs each of which must be equipped on RequirementsCharacterID. Null/empty means the condition is not checked.

RequiredItemIDs.description: ItemIDs each of which must be present in the player's inventory (TotalAmount > 0). Null/empty means the condition is not checked.

RequirementsCharacterID.description: Character against which MinCharacterLevel and RequiredEquippedItemIDs are checked. Null/empty falls back to DefaultData.Main.

x-enum-descriptions: First claim yields 0 and sets LastCollectAt = now. No write on read; player forfeits the first accrual.
On the very first access (incl. read-only), the server initializes LastCollectAt = now. Accrual starts on first sight; costs a DB write on first read.
Accrual counted from AvailableFromUtc. Falls back to now when null. Late joiners get income for the elapsed period (capped by MaxAccumulationSeconds).

IdleRateConfig.description: Accrual rate formula composition. All addends are summed, then multiplied by the best matching premium multiplier.

BaseRatePerSecond.description: Constant base rate in units per second. Applied to every player unconditionally.

BoardRankCoefficient.description: Coefficient multiplied by user.PublicData.BoardRank and added to the rate. 0 disables the addend.

EquipmentBonusEnabled.description: Whether to include the sum of IdleRateBonus from items equipped on EquipmentCharacterID. False disables the addend.

EquipmentCharacterID.description: Character from which to compute the equipment bonus. Null/empty falls back to DefaultData.Main.

PowerCoefficient.description: Coefficient multiplied by user.PublicData.Power and added to the rate. 0 disables the addend.

PremiumMultipliers.description: Premium rate multipliers. One best-matching multiplier is picked (highest MinPremiumTier) — multipliers do not stack. Defaults to 1.0 when none match.

LimitSpec.description: Unified anti-farm limits ("how much / how often"). Replaces TriggerLimits (Scheduling), DealNodeLimitsDefinition (DealOffer), StoreOfferRules caps (Store) and ClaimRewardDefinition sliding fields (Reward). 0 on an axis = no limit. Superset of axes with DIFFERENT enforcement semantics: DailyCap/DailyWeightCap = calendar UTC day; MaxPerWindow/WindowSeconds = sliding window. Usually one set is filled per system, the rest = 0. Counters are stored/enforced by each system; this is config thresholds only.

DailyCap.description: Cap on triggers/actions per calendar day (UTC). 0 = no limit.

DailyWeightCap.description: Cap on weight (e.g. token amount) per calendar day (UTC). 0 = no limit.

MaxPerWindow.description: Sliding window: max triggers within WindowSeconds. 0 = disabled.

PerActivationCap.description: Cap within a single activation/session. 0 = no limit.

TotalCap.description: Lifetime cap per user. 0 = no limit.

WindowSeconds.description: Sliding-window length (seconds). Used only when MaxPerWindow > 0.

PremiumTierBonus.description: Percentage bonus on ResourceGrant.Standard for a premium tier. All Standard Amounts are multiplied by (1 + Bonus) with Math.Ceiling rounding. Applies only to Standard; in Replace mode the bonused Standard is wiped when any PremiumTier matches. Best matching tier wins, bonuses do not stack. Symmetric to PremiumTierDiscount.

Bonus.description: Bonus as a SHARE: 0.1 = +10%, 1.0 = double (x2). Empty or 0 = no bonus. The unit is the same across the whole platform — never a 0..100 percent.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PremiumTierBundle.description: Per-tier bundle describing a structurally different set of resources (different ItemIDs/tokens/currencies) available only to subscribers. Used in both ResourceGrant.PremiumTiers (rewards) and ResourceConsume.PremiumTiers (price). Differs from PremiumTierBonus/PremiumTierDiscount which only modify Standard Amounts by percentage.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

Resources.description: Items, currencies and tokens of this tier. Entries with Amount=0 are valid and mean 'skip'. Empty/null Resources in Consume.PremiumTiers means 'premium pays nothing' (equivalent to Discounts: 1.0).

PremiumTierMultiplier.description: Premium multiplier of an arbitrary value (e.g. idle accrual rate) — third type of premium modifier alongside PremiumTierBonus and PremiumTierDiscount. Best matching tier wins, multipliers do not stack. If no tier matches, effective multiplier is 1.0.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum tier required to qualify for this modifier.

Multiplier.description: Multiplier value. 1.0 = neutral, 2.0 = double, 0.5 = half. Not clamped by the platform; consumer code is responsible for validating non-positive values.

RequiredPremiumID.description: Optional specific subscription ID. null = any subscription matching MinPremiumTier.

PresetBinding.description: Wiring for one preset block of an entity: a reference into the module's preset registry + optional keys to drop. Reusable Core container, one per preset-able block, held inside the entity's Presets container. Replaces the former scattered flat *PresetID / *Remove fields. Combination is data-driven, no mode (PresetResolver): no PresetID -> inline only; preset + empty inline -> preset; preset + inline -> merge (preset base + inline overrides/adds by key), Remove drops keys. For a single object (Character Equipment) there is nothing to key-merge, so inline wins when both are present.

PresetID.description: Preset key in the module registry (e.g. LeaderboardDefinitions.Presets.Milestones[PresetID]). Empty/null = preset unused (inline layer only).

Remove.description: Keys removed from the merged result. Dictionary key for dictionaries; element key for keyed lists (Rank / SlotID / RuleID). null = remove nothing. Ignored when no preset is set.

ResourceBundle.description: Set of items, currencies and tokens for a single operation direction (grant only or consume only).

ResourceEntry.description: Universal container for a single entry in a resource bundle (item or currency). The set of populated fields depends on Type: Item uses CatalogID/ItemID/Amount; VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency uses CurrencyID/Amount; Purchase uses only ProductID (paid in a store).

Amount.description: Amount of the resource. Used by every type except Purchase, where the quantity is decided by the store itself and this field is ignored. Amount=0 is valid in Consume.PremiumTiers and means 'do not charge'.

AmountUsd.description: CryptoCurrency only: the amount in USD instead of a token count. At the moment of the operation the engine converts it to tokens at the LIVE market price of the token (charge: rounded up to a whole token; grant: rounded down). When set, Amount is ignored; the operation result carries the converted Amount.

CatalogID.description: Item catalog identifier. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs (e.g. "main", "season").

CurrencyID.description: Currency identifier. Used only when Type is VirtualCurrency or CryptoCurrency. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies or cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

ItemID.description: Item identifier within the catalog. Used only when Type is Item. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Item.Catalogs[Catalog].Items.

ProductID.description: IAP product identifier. Used only when Type is Purchase. Corresponds to a key in cfg.Purchase.Products — OUR stable product ID, not the store SKU (per-store SKUs live in IapProductDefinition.StoreProductIDs).

Type.description: Resource type. Determines which fields must be populated: Item (catalog item), VirtualCurrency (off-chain), CryptoCurrency (on-chain), or Purchase (real-money payment in a store).

x-enum-descriptions: Catalog item. Requires CatalogID, ItemID and Amount.
In-game (off-chain) virtual currency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.VirtualCurrencies.
On-chain cryptocurrency. Requires CurrencyID and Amount. Looked up in cfg.Currency.CryptoCurrencies.

Real-money payment in a store. Requires only ProductID (a product from cfg.Purchase.Products); the amount and currency are decided by the store from the SKU price tier. NOT a storable resource and never passes through ResourceService — the money is paid outside before the server learns about it, so the entry is consumed by the receipt check (ExternalPaymentGate) and stripped before the resource operation. Allowed only in Consume and only for Consumable products.

Rewarded-video credit. One credit equals one verified ad view that can be spent in systems requiring rewarded video (lootbox open, reward double, re-roll, booster). Granted +1 per server-verified view, or as N from milestones/quests/premium perks; spent -1 per gated action.

ResourceGrant.description: Grant direction container for ResourceOperation. Two independent premium mechanisms over Standard: PremiumBonuses applies a percentage uplift to Standard (single best tier wins, no stack), and PremiumTiers provides structurally different rewards governed by cfg.Reward.TierRewards (Additive or Replace mode; in Replace the bonused Standard is wiped). Both mechanisms can be used together or independently.

PremiumBonuses.description: Percentage uplift on Standard for premium players. Single best matching tier wins (no stacking): Amount = ceil(Amount * (1 + Bonus)). Wiped under Mode=Replace if any PremiumTier matches.

PremiumTiers.description: Structurally different rewards for premium players (different ItemID/Target/...). Governed by global cfg.Reward.TierRewards.RewardMode (Additive/Replace) and RewardStackLowerTiers.

Standard.description: Base — what to grant to all players including F2P.

RewardAvailability.description: Reward availability block: audience gate plus claim limits. Direct analogue of QuestAvailability and TimedBoostAvailability. All fields are nullable without initializers — required by preset merging. Read only via RewardDefinitionDefaults.

Gate.description: Who the reward is available to. null/empty = everyone. Resolved by SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes.

Limits.description: Claim limits (CooldownSeconds, MaxPerWindow + WindowSeconds, TotalCap). 0 on an axis = unlimited. null = no limits. Applies to ClaimRewardDefinition; unused by other reward types.

x-enum-descriptions: Rewards are granted on top of the base Rewards.
Rewards fully replace the base Rewards.

RewardPresetBindings.description: Container of preset wiring — one PresetBinding per block. Inline data lives on the definition itself. null = presets unused.

Availability.description: Preset binding for the Availability block.

RewardPresetRegistry.description: Registry of reusable reward config blocks. The field mirrors the same-named definition block. Analogue of QuestPresetRegistry.

Availability.description: Reusable availability blocks (gate + limits), keyed by PresetID.

RewardProgressionMultiplierSpec.description: Milestone overlay: progression-based reward multiplier (cash multiplier). Scales targeted milestone rewards of ANY type — currencies, items and event tokens — by a multiplier derived from a configurable player progression metric (Source) via a shared platform curve (ScalarCurveSpec). What gets scaled is a strictly typed set IncludeRewards/ExcludeRewards (ResourceBundle, matched by Type + ID); empty Include = ALL. Applied in RewardProgressionResolver inside MilestoneRewardResolver, after bonus-window and season-tier. null on a milestone = disabled.

Anchor.description: Progress value from which the curve starts counting. Empty = from zero.

Curve.description: Multiplier curve: how the multiplier grows with progress. Evaluated over a base of 1.0, so an unset curve means a multiplier of 1 and an unchanged reward. Shape/PerStep/Points/Interpolation/MinResult/MaxResult are documented on ScalarCurveSpec.

ExcludeRewards.description: Rewards to exclude (same ResourceBundle shape as IncludeRewards). Takes precedence: a reward matched by Type + ID is never scaled. null/empty = no exclusions.

IncludeRewards.description: Rewards to scale — a strictly typed set (ResourceBundle): currencies/items in Entries (matched by Type + ID: ItemID for items, else CurrencyID), event tokens in EventTokens (matched by Address.EntityID). Entry Amount is ignored — this is a selector, not a grant. null/empty (no Entries and no EventTokens) = apply to ALL milestone rewards.

Source.description: Which player progression metric to read (see ProgressionSource).

SourceKey.description: Extra key for sources that need a parameter: VirtualCurrencyBalance -> CurrencyID; SeasonTier -> SeasonChainID; EventTokenTotalEarned -> "{bucket}:{entityID}" (bucket: TimedEvent/Leaderboard/Season/CoopEvent/Quest/DealOffer); CharacterLevel -> CharacterID (empty = "Main"). Ignored for other sources.

ScalarCurveSpec.description: Scalar curve f(base, step): how a value grows with a level, rank, stage or count. THE MODULE'S RULE: an empty field does nothing — an unset curve is the identity f(base,n)=base, an unset bound means there is no bound. All rates are shares (0.1 = +10%), never multipliers, so 0 and empty always mean the same thing.

Base.description: Base the curve is computed from. Empty = use the base supplied by the caller. Fill it only where the base is a publisher setting (a multiplier starting at 1.5, a table's value before its first point) — where the base comes from data (a stat value, a level price, an item bonus) leaving it empty is required, otherwise it overrides the real base.

GrowthRate.description: Compounding rate per step (Shape=Geometric): 0.1 = x1.1 per step. Empty or 0 = no growth.

Interpolation.description: How to interpolate between points. Empty = Step.

MaxResult.description: Upper bound of the result. Empty = there is NO upper bound (not 0).

MinResult.description: Lower bound of the result. Empty = there is NO lower bound (not 0).

PerStep.description: Units added per step (Shape=PerStep). Empty or 0 = no growth.

PerStepRate.description: Share of the base added per step (Shape=PerStepRate): 0.1 = +10% of base per step. Empty or 0 = no growth.

Points.description: Table breakpoints (Shape=Table or TableAbsolute). Empty = no growth.

Shape.description: Curve shape. Empty = Flat, i.e. no growth.

TailGrowthRate.description: Growth beyond the last table point (share per step). Empty = hold the last point's value.

SegmentGate.description: Unified "who it is available/applies to" gate. Replaces BoostSegmentGate (TimedBoost), MailboxSegmentDefinition filters and StoreOfferRules premium fields. All conditions are AND-ed. An empty/unset field = no constraint on that axis; an empty/null gate = available to everyone. Resolved by SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes.

ActiveWithinDays.description: Active within the last X days (matches Usage.LastActiveAt). 0 = no restriction.

Countries.description: Country filter (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; matches PublicData.Country, else RegistrationCountry). Empty = all countries.

Experiment.description: A/B experiment condition: the gate passes only if the player is assigned to the required variant (ExperimentVariantCondition). null = not applied. A/B variants thus reuse the whole SegmentGate stack: two configs, each gated to its variant. Assignment is read from UserDataDocument.Experiments (sticky, stable-hash — see ExperimentAssigner).

MaxLevel.description: Maximum Board Rank. 0 = no upper bound.

MinLevel.description: Minimum Board Rank (matches PublicData.BoardRank). 0 = no lower bound.

MinPremiumTier.description: Minimum active premium tier (matches Premium.MaxActiveTier). 0 = no requirement.

Platforms.description: Platforms the entity is available on. Empty/null = all. Unlike the other axes this one comes from the request platform (IGSService.ClientPlatform), not from the player document, and is passed to SegmentGateEvaluator.Passes as a separate REQUIRED argument. The axis is skipped when the platform is Unknown — deliberately soft, because it governs what is shown, not what is charged: payments are guarded by PriceOptionSelector.IsAvailableOn, where Unknown does not pass a non-empty platform list. Not needed to hide entities that simply cannot be paid for on a platform: storefronts already drop whatever has no available price option.

RegisteredWithinDays.description: Registered no earlier than X days ago (new players; matches RegistrationDate). 0 = no restriction.

RequiredPremiumIDs.description: Required active premium IDs (ANY of the list is enough, via PremiumHelpers.GetActivePremiumIDs). Empty = no requirement.

Segments.description: Allowed economy segments (matches PlayerEconomyTuningState.Segment: "F2P","Dolphin","Whale","VIP"). Empty = any.

Tutorial.description: Tutorial condition: the gate passes only if the player is in the required progression state (TutorialGateCondition). null = not applied. By the same trick as Experiment, this gives "after onboarding" gating in every module already using SegmentGate, with no edits to them. To close a whole module there is a cheaper path — TutorialGlobalSettings.Blocking: one check in ClientRun instead of a condition on every entity.

TierRewardSettings.description: Global tier-reward resolution rules applied to ALL tiered systems of the title (premium, season, battle pass, etc.). One mode per title.

RewardMode.description: Tier-reward resolution mode. Additive: tier rewards are added on top of the base reward. Replace: tier rewards fully replace the base reward.

RewardStackLowerTiers.description: Whether lower-tier rewards stack with higher-tier ones. True: a player at tier 5 gets tiers 1..5 merged. False: only the best matching tier.

TutorialGateCondition.description: "The player finished the tutorial" condition — embedded in SegmentGate.Tutorial exactly as ExperimentVariantCondition is embedded in SegmentGate.Experiment. Thanks to that, tutorial gating works for free in EVERY module already using SegmentGate (Store / DealOffer / Quest / Reward / Leaderboard / ...). This is the per-entity gating level; to close a whole module use TutorialBlockingPolicy, which is cheaper.

FlowIDs.description: Flows whose state is checked. Empty = the condition is not applied (the gate passes). Multiple entries are AND-ed: "after the intro AND after the raid tutorial".

Mode.description: What exactly must hold for those flows. Default Completed.

Negate.description: Invert the condition. Needed for the reverse case — "show this starter offer ONLY to players still in the tutorial". Default false.

SkippedCountsAsCompleted.description: Whether a Skipped flow counts as finished under Mode = Completed. Default true: if the publisher allowed skipping, the skipper must get the same game as the completer.

StepID.description: The step that must be reached. Read only when Mode = StepReached, and applied to every flow in FlowIDs.

x-enum-descriptions: The flow is finished. Default.
The flow is started (in progress or already finished).
A specific step has been reached (TutorialGateCondition.StepID).

value.description: Root config for universal, system-agnostic rewards. Umbrella over four independent subsystems: DailyCalendars, IdleAccruals, Comebacks, Claims.

Claims.description: Simple click-to-claim rewards. Supports one-shot bonuses, repeating claims with rolling-window limits, and server-triggered rewards. Empty/null disables the subsystem.

Comebacks.description: Comeback reward configs (return-after-absence). Each is an independent policy. Empty/null disables the subsystem.

DailyCalendars.description: Daily-login calendars. Each calendar is an independent day-by-day progression. Empty/null disables the subsystem.

IdleAccruals.description: Idle-income accruals. Each is an independent resource stream with its own rate, cap and activation requirements. Empty/null disables the subsystem.

MilestoneRewardMultiplier.description: Title-wide progression-based milestone reward multiplier (cash multiplier). Applies to ALL milestones of every system (TimedEvent, Leaderboard, DealOffer, Quest, CommunityChest, Referral) via MilestoneRewardResolver as the last overlay. Targeting (IncludeRewards/ExcludeRewards, ResourceBundle by Type+ID; empty = all rewards) is configured in the spec. null = disabled.

Presets.description: Registry of reusable reward config blocks. null = presets unused. Expanded once when the config is materialized (PlatformCache.ResolveCompositeSections).
